seed-reddit-kyoto.title: r/JapanTravel night-bus note cleared 1.2k upvotes
seed-reddit-kyoto.body: The Kyoto guide's last-train timing was posted as a first-person note, not a promo. The guide link sat in the second paragraph after the station name. Most clicks came from a comment that asked for the map, so the next draft should lead with the concrete time.

seed-quora-paris.title: Quora answer on a 3-day Paris plan kept sending readers to the Louvre section
seed-quora-paris.body: The question was whether three days is enough. The answer used the guide's day-by-day split and named ticket prices before the link. Readers who wanted the Mona Lisa line tip opened the full guide.

seed-pinterest-bali.title: Ubud rice-terrace pin passed 8.6k saves
seed-pinterest-bali.body: The pin used the terrace photo already in the Bali guide, with alt text that names Ubud. The board is Island Food and Temples. The description stays under two sentences and ends on the guide path.

seed-tip-table.title: Put the local price table above the first food heading
seed-tip-table.body: Guides that open the meal section with a price table hold readers longer than guides that start with a scenery paragraph. Keep three rows: dish, place, and a local price. That block is also the easiest piece to reuse in a Quora answer.

about.title: About BlueLog Trip
about.mission1: BlueLog Trip is a local guide desk. We research a city, draft a walkable route and neighborhood food notes, then check the guide before it is published for readers planning a walk, a meal, or a short stay.
about.mission2: The desk covers Asia, Europe, and the Americas. We write original guides for people on the ground. We are not a booking cart, and we do not scrape other sites and republish their pages.
about.trust1: Each guide starts from local research, then passes an editorial check. A guide marked Verified Guide has been reviewed for publication. A guide marked Verified Travel Guide has been read by that checking process and may still be waiting for a final publish step.
about.trust2: Prices, opening hours, and transit rules still belong to the venue or the city. We say so in the guide and ask readers to confirm them on site. Factual corrections are welcome at <mail>{{email}}</mail>.
about.trust3: Advertising, including Google AdSense, may appear on published pages. Ads do not change the route we recommend. How cookies are used is explained in the Privacy Policy.
about.contactBody: Editorial questions, missing neighborhoods, and privacy requests go to the same desk: <mail>{{email}}</mail>. Include the city and the guide title so we can open the published page.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.whoBody: BlueLog Trip publishes city walking routes, neighborhood food notes, and community trip logs. This policy explains what the site collects and how advertising partners, including Google, may use cookies.
privacy.collect1: When you search, open a guide, or send a contact message, the site may process the text you submit, basic device and browser data, and the pages you view. We use that information to show guides, keep the site working, and understand which pages are useful.
privacy.collect2: A visitor counter stores a salted hash of your IP address so the same browser is counted once per day. We do not sell personal information, and you do not need an account to read published guides.
privacy.cookies1: BlueLog Trip uses essential cookies and local storage for interface choices, such as a draft community log kept in your browser. Those tools are not used by themselves to build an advertising profile.
privacy.cookies2: Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this website or other websites. Third-party advertising partners may also use web beacons and similar technologies to recognize your browser across sites. BlueLog Trip does not control the cookies those partners set.
privacy.cookies3: Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to users based on their visit to this site and other sites on the Internet. Those cookies may collect or receive information from your browser, including a cookie identifier, IP address, browser type, and pages viewed, and use that information to provide advertisements and to measure ad performance.
privacy.adsenseTitle: Google AdSense and the DART cookie
privacy.adsense1: This site is supported by advertising, including Google AdSense. Google, as a third-party vendor, uses cookies to serve ads on BlueLog Trip.
privacy.adsense2: Google's use of the DART cookie enables it to serve ads to visitors based on their visit to this site and other sites on the Internet. Visitors may opt out of the use of the DART cookie by visiting the Google ad and content network privacy policy at <ads>{{adsUrl}}</ads>.
privacy.adsense3: You may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings at <settings>{{settingsUrl}}</settings>. You can also opt out of some third-party vendors' use of cookies for personalized advertising by visiting <choices>{{choicesUrl}}</choices> or, in the European Economic Area, <eea>{{eeaUrl}}</eea>. Browser settings can block cookies. Blocking cookies may limit some site features and will not remove all advertising.
privacy.othersBody: Guides may link to maps, photos, or external sites. Those sites have their own privacy practices. A link from BlueLog Trip is not an endorsement of that site's data handling.
privacy.contactBody: Questions about this policy can be sent to <mail>{{email}}</mail>.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.use1: These terms cover your use of BlueLog Trip, including city guides, community logs, and the pages linked from the site footer. By using the site you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.
terms.use2: BlueLog Trip provides travel writing for general information. Guides are not a booking service, a tour operator, or professional safety, medical, or legal advice. Routes, prices, hours, and local rules change. Confirm details with the venue or local authority before you travel.
terms.postsBody: Community logs you submit should be your own words. Do not post content that is unlawful, misleading, or that infringes someone else's rights. We may remove a post that breaks these terms.
terms.contentBody: Guides, layout, and the BlueLog Trip name are owned by BlueLog Trip unless a credit says otherwise. You may share a link to a published guide. You may not copy the site wholesale or present our guides as your own commercial product.
terms.adsBody: Some pages display third-party advertisements, including Google AdSense. Advertisers are responsible for their own offers. A displayed ad is not a recommendation from BlueLog Trip.
terms.liabilityBody: The site is provided as available. To the extent the law allows, BlueLog Trip is not liable for travel decisions you make from a guide, for third-party ads, or for interruptions in the service.
terms.contactBody: Questions about these terms can be sent to <mail>{{email}}</mail>.
